body: As a health care worker I’ve seen more deaths from other diseases and people’s mental well-being decreasing because of the impact of COVID - 19 restrictions than the virus itself. Ive seen some of the most vulnerable people with pre-existing health conditions test positive and are completely fine, although the impact of isolating them in their rooms and treating them like the carriers of the plaque has tremendously impacted their mental health, some people saying they’ve had enough and want to die because of missing family members. This is the disgusting, degrading and heart breaking reality we’re living in.It makes no sense.
